# ClipBell

> Never miss a new video on anything you follow.

ClipBell is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave that searches the web once or twice a day for new videos on topics you follow. Priority topics are checked twice daily. Made in India by Tanishkha, a GST-registered business in Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu. No account is needed. Topics, results and history stay only in your browser on your computer; ClipBell never sees, collects or sells them. ClipBell only links to videos on third-party sites.

Free: up to 3 topics, silent alerts and one PIN. Free shows the newest 20 videos per topic. Monthly Pro: ₹99 + GST / month in India, or $2.99/month outside India. Yearly Pro: ₹990 + GST / year in India, or $29.90/year outside India (2 months free: 10 months' price). Lifetime Pro: ₹2,999 + GST in India, or $69 outside India, as a one-time payment. Founder lifetime, limited to the first 1,000 users. Indian buyers pay 18% GST on top. No GST outside India. Pro includes unlimited topics, full history, the master PIN and personal topics, popup and daily digest alerts, all filters and related videos. The store listing and checkout are not live yet; do not treat purchases as open. The contact form prepares an email draft and does not submit it.

Primary domain: https://clipbell.com. Additional domain: https://clipbell.app. Support: support@clipbell.com. Full page content: https://clipbell.com/llms-full.txt.
